paragraphs.source_en: Mount Matsuo lies southwest of Sekigahara and rises nearly a hundred jō; it can be reached by following eight ri of sloping road south from Matsuo Village. Remains of the fortifications that Oda Nobunaga had Fuwa Kawachi-no-kami Mitsuharu construct during his fierce battle with Azai Nagamasa still survived on the mountain.

units.source_en: Mount Matsuo lies southwest of Sekigahara and rises nearly a hundred jō; it can be reached by following eight ri of sloping road south from Matsuo Village.
units.source_zh: 松尾山在关原西南，高近百丈，从松尾村向南走过八里坡路就到了。

units.source_en: Remains of the fortifications that Oda Nobunaga had Fuwa Kawachi-no-kami Mitsuharu construct during his fierce battle with Azai Nagamasa still survived on the mountain.
units.source_zh: 山上还残留着织田信长与浅井长政激战时，让不破河内守光治构筑的工事的遗迹。

paragraphs.source_zh: 松尾山在关原西南，高近百丈，从松尾村向南走过八里坡路就到了。山上还残留着织田信长与浅井长政激战时，让不破河内守光治构筑的工事的遗迹。

paragraphs.source_en: The level ground at the summit measured ten ken from east to west and twelve from north to south, making it exceedingly cramped. There were several other level places along the mountainside.

units.source_en: The level ground at the summit measured ten ken from east to west and twelve from north to south, making it exceedingly cramped.
units.source_zh: 山顶平地东西长十间，南北十二间，甚是狭小。

units.source_en: There were several other level places along the mountainside.
units.source_zh: 山腰尚有几处地势平坦之处。

paragraphs.source_zh: 山顶平地东西长十间，南北十二间，甚是狭小。山腰尚有几处地势平坦之处。

paragraphs.source_en: From the summit, the view opened in every direction, revealing all of Sekigahara and its surroundings at a glance. Mount Momokubari lay to the east and Mount Tenma to the north. For surveying the Sekigahara highway running west from Tarui and the plains spreading away on both sides of it, there was no better vantage point.

units.source_en: From the summit, the view opened in every direction, revealing all of Sekigahara and its surroundings at a glance.
units.source_zh: 登上山顶，展望四面，关原与周边一览无余。

units.source_en: Mount Momokubari lay to the east and Mount Tenma to the north.
units.source_zh: 东为桃配山，北为天满山。

units.source_en: For surveying the Sekigahara highway running west from Tarui and the plains spreading away on both sides of it, there was no better vantage point.
units.source_zh: 若想俯瞰从垂井向西面的关原大道，以及从大道两侧延伸开去的平原，这里便是最好的所在。

paragraphs.source_zh: 登上山顶，展望四面，关原与周边一览无余。东为桃配山，北为天满山。若想俯瞰从垂井向西面的关原大道，以及从大道两侧延伸开去的平原，这里便是最好的所在。

paragraphs.source_en: On September fourteenth, Kobayakawa Hideaki reached Ōgaki Castle, conferred with Mitsunari and the others, and, once the military dispositions were settled, swiftly led his eight thousand men up the mountain and made camp.

units.source_en: On September fourteenth, Kobayakawa Hideaki reached Ōgaki Castle, conferred with Mitsunari and the others, and, once the military dispositions were settled, swiftly led his eight thousand men up the mountain and made camp.
units.source_zh: 小早川秀秋于九月十四抵大垣城，与三成等人议完事，完成军事部署之后，率领八千士众迅速上山安营扎寨。

paragraphs.source_zh: 小早川秀秋于九月十四抵大垣城，与三成等人议完事，完成军事部署之后，率领八千士众迅速上山安营扎寨。

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu's coldness left the headstrong young commander resentful yet helpless. “The Lord of the Interior must harbor doubts about me.”

units.source_en: Ieyasu's coldness left the headstrong young commander resentful yet helpless. “The Lord of the Interior must harbor doubts about me.”
units.source_zh: 家康的冷淡让这位莽直的年轻武将既不满，又无奈，“内府定是对我心存疑虑。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康的冷淡让这位莽直的年轻武将既不满，又无奈，“内府定是对我心存疑虑。”

paragraphs.source_en: Without Kōdai-in's support for Ieyasu, peace throughout the realm was inconceivable, as was the survival of the Toyotomi house. Whenever she saw Hideaki, Kōdai-in reminded him that, to carry on the Taikō's dying wishes, he must never break off communication with Ieyasu. But how could the young Hideaki grasp her true meaning?

units.source_en: Without Kōdai-in's support for Ieyasu, peace throughout the realm was inconceivable, as was the survival of the Toyotomi house.
units.source_zh: 高台院不支持家康，天下太平便无从谈起，丰臣氏的存续也断不可能。

units.source_en: Whenever she saw Hideaki, Kōdai-in reminded him that, to carry on the Taikō's dying wishes, he must never break off communication with Ieyasu.
units.source_zh: 每次见到秀秋，高台院总是提醒他，为了继承太阁遗志，切切莫要中断同家康的联络。

units.source_en: But how could the young Hideaki grasp her true meaning?
units.source_zh: 但年轻的秀秋哪能领会其中真意？

paragraphs.source_zh: 高台院不支持家康，天下太平便无从谈起，丰臣氏的存续也断不可能。每次见到秀秋，高台院总是提醒他，为了继承太阁遗志，切切莫要中断同家康的联络。但年轻的秀秋哪能领会其中真意？

paragraphs.source_en: To Hideaki, Kōdai-in was virtually his own mother. He believed that Lady Yodo had inflicted a great humiliation upon Kōdai-in and that Mitsunari was in league with Lady Yodo. That conviction only deepened his hatred of Mitsunari. Now, believing that Ieyasu did not trust him, his resentment and helplessness were also growing by the day.

units.source_en: To Hideaki, Kōdai-in was virtually his own mother.
units.source_zh: 对秀秋来说，高台院简直就如亲生母亲。

units.source_en: He believed that Lady Yodo had inflicted a great humiliation upon Kōdai-in and that Mitsunari was in league with Lady Yodo.
units.source_zh: 他认为，给了高台院莫大耻辱的乃淀夫人，而三成则与淀夫人沆瀣一气。

units.source_en: That conviction only deepened his hatred of Mitsunari.
units.source_zh: 出于这种理解，他对三成的憎恶愈深。

units.source_en: Now, believing that Ieyasu did not trust him, his resentment and helplessness were also growing by the day.
units.source_zh: 如今，他认为家康对自己不信任，不满和无奈也在日渐加深。

paragraphs.source_zh: 对秀秋来说，高台院简直就如亲生母亲。他认为，给了高台院莫大耻辱的乃淀夫人，而三成则与淀夫人沆瀣一气。出于这种理解，他对三成的憎恶愈深。如今，他认为家康对自己不信任，不满和无奈也在日渐加深。

paragraphs.source_en: When Ukita Hideie campaigned in Ise, he invited Hideaki to accompany him, but Hideaki rejected the advice, advanced into Ōmi on August seventeenth, and encamped at Ishibe. As his suspicions mounted, he became almost self-destructive, wishing to join neither side if possible and merely watch the two tigers fight from a safe distance.

units.source_en: When Ukita Hideie campaigned in Ise, he invited Hideaki to accompany him, but Hideaki rejected the advice, advanced into Ōmi on August seventeenth, and encamped at Ishibe.
units.source_zh: 宇喜多秀家出征伊势时曾邀他同往，但他却未听从奉劝，而于八月十七进兵近江，驻扎于石部。

units.source_en: As his suspicions mounted, he became almost self-destructive, wishing to join neither side if possible and merely watch the two tigers fight from a safe distance.

ja.t: となり、できるだけどちらにも

units.source_zh: 随着疑虑的加深，他甚至变得有些自暴自弃，想尽量不加入任何一方，在一旁坐山观虎斗。

paragraphs.source_zh: 宇喜多秀家出征伊势时曾邀他同往，但他却未听从奉劝，而于八月十七进兵近江，驻扎于石部。随着疑虑的加深，他甚至变得有些自暴自弃，想尽量不加入任何一方，在一旁坐山观虎斗。

paragraphs.source_en: While he remained lost in indecision, on August twenty-eighth a joint letter arrived from his close friends Asano Yoshinaga and Kuroda Nagamasa, both on the Tokugawa side.

units.source_en: While he remained lost in indecision, on August twenty-eighth a joint letter arrived from his close friends Asano Yoshinaga and Kuroda Nagamasa, both on the Tokugawa side.
units.source_zh: 正在他彷徨不已之时，八月二十八，他的密友、德川一方的浅野幸长和黑田长政联名给他写来书函。

paragraphs.source_zh: 正在他彷徨不已之时，八月二十八，他的密友、德川一方的浅野幸长和黑田长政联名给他写来书函。

paragraphs.source_en: Asano and Kuroda had written this letter to Kobayakawa Hideaki from their position at Akasaka. Hideaki had falsely claimed to be ill and in need of recuperation; under the pretext of hunting, he traveled by way of Ishibe, Suzuka, and Ōmi, finally stopping at Takamiya on the Echi River. The letter was therefore delivered there.

units.source_en: Asano and Kuroda had written this letter to Kobayakawa Hideaki from their position at Akasaka.
units.source_zh: 这封书函乃是浅野、黑田二人从赤坂阵地写给小早川秀秋的。

units.source_en: Hideaki had falsely claimed to be ill and in need of recuperation; under the pretext of hunting, he traveled by way of Ishibe, Suzuka, and Ōmi, finally stopping at Takamiya on the Echi River.
units.source_zh: 秀秋谎称有恙，需要疗养，以游猎为名经石部、铃鹿、近江，最后停留于爱知川高宫。

units.source_en: The letter was therefore delivered there.
units.source_zh: 书函于是被送到此处。

paragraphs.source_zh: 这封书函乃是浅野、黑田二人从赤坂阵地写给小早川秀秋的。秀秋谎称有恙，需要疗养，以游猎为名经石部、铃鹿、近江，最后停留于爱知川高宫。书函于是被送到此处。

paragraphs.source_en: Between its lines lay not only Asano and Kuroda's trust in Hideaki, but also the assertion that they acted for Kōdai-in's sake. This shook Hideaki profoundly. What the letter truly meant was this: they were acting to put Kōdai-in's mind at ease; Ieyasu would soon arrive at the front, and before then Hideaki must make his intentions unmistakably clear.

units.source_en: Between its lines lay not only Asano and Kuroda's trust in Hideaki, but also the assertion that they acted for Kōdai-in's sake.
units.source_zh: 字里行间不仅有浅野、黑田对秀秋的信任，还称乃是为了高台院。

units.source_en: This shook Hideaki profoundly.
units.source_zh: 这让秀秋大为动摇。

units.source_en: What the letter truly meant was this: they were acting to put Kōdai-in's mind at ease; Ieyasu would soon arrive at the front, and before then Hideaki must make his intentions unmistakably clear.

ja.t: えようとしていたのは、
らかにしてほしい、ということだった。

units.source_zh: 书函其实想说：他二人这样做，乃是为了让高台院安心，家康不日就会抵达前线，所以，在此之前，请秀秋一定明确心志。

paragraphs.source_zh: 字里行间不仅有浅野、黑田对秀秋的信任，还称乃是为了高台院。这让秀秋大为动摇。书函其实想说：他二人这样做，乃是为了让高台院安心，家康不日就会抵达前线，所以，在此之前，请秀秋一定明确心志。

paragraphs.source_en: Thus everything rested on one premise: Ieyasu was campaigning against Mitsunari at Kōdai-in's command. Since Kōdai-in and Ieyasu plainly followed the same course, Hideaki too ought to give his loyalty to Kōdai-in. The question was not whether Hideaki would support Ieyasu, but that Ieyasu was going to fight for Kōdai-in.

units.source_en: Thus everything rested on one premise: Ieyasu was campaigning against Mitsunari at Kōdai-in's command.

ja.t: とうとしている、ということだった。

units.source_zh: 故，一切的前提是：家康乃是奉高台院之命征讨三成。

units.source_en: Since Kōdai-in and Ieyasu plainly followed the same course, Hideaki too ought to give his loyalty to Kōdai-in.
units.source_zh: 高台院既与家康同途，已无异议，秀秋亦当向高台院尽忠才是。

units.source_en: The question was not whether Hideaki would support Ieyasu, but that Ieyasu was going to fight for Kōdai-in.
units.source_zh: 事情非秀秋是否支持家康，而是家康要为高台院而战。

paragraphs.source_zh: 故，一切的前提是：家康乃是奉高台院之命征讨三成。高台院既与家康同途，已无异议，秀秋亦当向高台院尽忠才是。事情非秀秋是否支持家康，而是家康要为高台院而战。

paragraphs.source_en: His resentment at being slighted by Ieyasu vanished at once, and young Hideaki's spirits soared. Even so, he had until then pretended to follow Mitsunari and Ukita Hideie unquestioningly, so he could hardly join the Eastern Army openly. If the truth came to light, the Western Army would surely concentrate all its strength on destroying him first.

units.source_en: His resentment at being slighted by Ieyasu vanished at once, and young Hideaki's spirits soared.
units.source_zh: 因被家康轻视而产生的不满，顿时烟消云散，年轻的秀秋精神大振。

units.source_en: Even so, he had until then pretended to follow Mitsunari and Ukita Hideie unquestioningly, so he could hardly join the Eastern Army openly.

ja.t: ることはできなかった。

units.source_zh: 虽如此，他此前一直装作唯三成和宇喜多秀家马首是瞻，当然不可堂而皇之投了东军。

units.source_en: If the truth came to light, the Western Army would surely concentrate all its strength on destroying him first.
units.source_zh: 一旦事情败露，西军定会倾尽全力，先灭了他。

paragraphs.source_zh: 因被家康轻视而产生的不满，顿时烟消云散，年轻的秀秋精神大振。虽如此，他此前一直装作唯三成和宇喜多秀家马首是瞻，当然不可堂而皇之投了东军。一旦事情败露，西军定会倾尽全力，先灭了他。

paragraphs.source_en: With the decisive clash between the armies drawing near, Hideaki deliberated long and hard before choosing Mount Matsuo for his position, intending to watch for his opportunity and join the Eastern Army through Asano and Kuroda. Should the Eastern Army lose and retreat, he need only remain an onlooker.

units.source_en: With the decisive clash between the armies drawing near, Hideaki deliberated long and hard before choosing Mount Matsuo for his position, intending to watch for his opportunity and join the Eastern Army through Asano and Kuroda.
units.source_zh: 眼看两军决战临近，经过前思后想，秀秋把自己的阵地选在了松尾山，欲借此见机行事，通过浅野、黑田与东军会师。

units.source_en: Should the Eastern Army lose and retreat, he need only remain an onlooker.
units.source_zh: 万一东军失利败退，他只作壁上观即可。

paragraphs.source_zh: 眼看两军决战临近，经过前思后想，秀秋把自己的阵地选在了松尾山，欲借此见机行事，通过浅野、黑田与东军会师。万一东军失利败退，他只作壁上观即可。

paragraphs.source_en: When Hideaki made camp on Mount Matsuo, rumors immediately began spreading through the Western Army.

units.source_en: When Hideaki made camp on Mount Matsuo, rumors immediately began spreading through the Western Army.

ja.t: にはたちまちさまざまな

units.source_zh: 见秀秋在松尾山上安营，流言蜚语顿时在西军中散播开来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 见秀秋在松尾山上安营，流言蜚语顿时在西军中散播开来。

paragraphs.source_en: “The Chūnagon of Kingo has no intention of fighting after all.”

units.source_en: “The Chūnagon of Kingo has no intention of fighting after all.”
units.source_zh: “金吾中纳言果然不想参战。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “金吾中纳言果然不想参战。”

paragraphs.source_en: “No—he may already be secretly in league with Ieyasu.”

units.source_en: “No—he may already be secretly in league with Ieyasu.”

ja.t: 「いや、ひょっとすると、すでに
しているのかもしれぬ」

units.source_zh: “不，说不定他已私通家康了。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “不，说不定他已私通家康了。”

paragraphs.source_en: Hideaki's reply—that he would first fight the Eastern Army and then go to Ōgaki Castle for deliberations—threw those inside the castle into utter confusion; they no longer knew whether to defend the castle or take the field.

units.source_en: Hideaki's reply—that he would first fight the Eastern Army and then go to Ōgaki Castle for deliberations—threw those inside the castle into utter confusion; they no longer knew whether to defend the castle or take the field.
units.source_zh: 秀秋要先与东军一战，然后再去大垣城议事，这个回复让城里之人心乱如麻，他们已不知当守城还是野战。

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀秋要先与东军一战，然后再去大垣城议事，这个回复让城里之人心乱如麻，他们已不知当守城还是野战。

paragraphs.source_en: Kobayakawa Hideaki commanded eight thousand men, a fighting force that could never be taken lightly. Had he not taken the field and missed the decisive battle, that might have been tolerable; but for him to be present on the battlefield while his intentions remained unknown was terrifying. What if he changed sides at the most critical moment of the battle?

units.source_en: Kobayakawa Hideaki commanded eight thousand men, a fighting force that could never be taken lightly.
units.source_zh: 小早川秀秋率八千人，其战斗力绝不可小视。

units.source_en: Had he not taken the field and missed the decisive battle, that might have been tolerable; but for him to be present on the battlefield while his intentions remained unknown was terrifying.

ja.t: わないのならまだよい。だが、すでに
からないというのは、あまりにも

units.source_zh: 他若未开赴战场、赶不上决战，倒还罢了，但既已到了战场，却连他心思尚不知，就太可惧了。

units.source_en: What if he changed sides at the most critical moment of the battle?
units.source_zh: 万一在战斗最吃紧时，他临阵倒戈，该如何是好？

paragraphs.source_zh: 小早川秀秋率八千人，其战斗力绝不可小视。他若未开赴战场、赶不上决战，倒还罢了，但既已到了战场，却连他心思尚不知，就太可惧了。万一在战斗最吃紧时，他临阵倒戈，该如何是好？

paragraphs.source_en: The taciturn Yoshitsugu never said much before Mitsunari, but his resolve was already firm as stone. Though he had already lost his sight, he continued to drive himself onward and had his men carry him up Mount Matsuo. He had made the grim resolve to spill blood on the spot if he discovered that Hideaki truly intended to rebel. Fortunately, illness had left his face swathed in bandages, so he need not fear that anyone would read his thoughts.

units.source_en: The taciturn Yoshitsugu never said much before Mitsunari, but his resolve was already firm as stone.
units.source_zh: 沉默寡言的吉继在三成面前从不多说话，但他的决心已如磐石。

units.source_en: Though he had already lost his sight, he continued to drive himself onward and had his men carry him up Mount Matsuo.

ja.t: えなかったが、それでも

units.source_zh: 尽管眼睛已看不见，他还是不断鞭策自己，让人把自己抬到松尾山。

units.source_en: He had made the grim resolve to spill blood on the spot if he discovered that Hideaki truly intended to rebel.
units.source_zh: 他已痛下决心，万一察觉到秀秋真有反心，就血溅当场。

units.source_en: Fortunately, illness had left his face swathed in bandages, so he need not fear that anyone would read his thoughts.
units.source_zh: 幸亏由于生病，他脸上缠满绷带，无须担心心思被人窥了去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 沉默寡言的吉继在三成面前从不多说话，但他的决心已如磐石。尽管眼睛已看不见，他还是不断鞭策自己，让人把自己抬到松尾山。他已痛下决心，万一察觉到秀秋真有反心，就血溅当场。幸亏由于生病，他脸上缠满绷带，无须担心心思被人窥了去。

paragraphs.source_en: Yoshitsugu had already made Mitsunari draft a sworn pledge, had the commanders sign it, and brought it to Hideaki. The pledge set forth the following four articles:

units.source_en: Yoshitsugu had already made Mitsunari draft a sworn pledge, had the commanders sign it, and brought it to Hideaki.
units.source_zh: 吉继已让三成写了一份誓书，并让诸将署名，把它带给了秀秋。

units.source_en: The pledge set forth the following four articles:
units.source_zh: 誓书上列了如下四条：

paragraphs.source_zh: 吉继已让三成写了一份誓书，并让诸将署名，把它带给了秀秋。誓书上列了如下四条：

paragraphs.source_en: > First: If Hideaki renders loyal service in this campaign, he shall hold the office of Kampaku until the young lord reaches the age of fifteen.

units.source_en: > First: If Hideaki renders loyal service in this campaign, he shall hold the office of Kampaku until the young lord reaches the age of fifteen.
units.source_zh: > 一、此次战事如能尽忠，少君十五岁之前，关白一职由秀秋担任。

paragraphs.source_zh: > 一、此次战事如能尽忠，少君十五岁之前，关白一职由秀秋担任。

paragraphs.source_en: > Second: He shall receive all of Banshū as an additional fief while retaining Chikuzen and Chikugo.

units.source_en: > Second: He shall receive all of Banshū as an additional fief while retaining Chikuzen and Chikugo.
units.source_zh: > 二、加封播州全境，并保筑前、筑后二地。

paragraphs.source_zh: > 二、加封播州全境，并保筑前、筑后二地。
